view_single_trace: generate an HTML trace viewer page from a single Gaia2 ExportedTrace JSON file
view_trace_directory: generate HTML trace viewer pages for all Gaia2 trace JSON files in a directory
serve_traces: start an HTTP server to serve Gaia2 trace viewer pages with live regeneration
load_trace_json: load and parse a Gaia2 ExportedTrace JSON file with deserialized world logs
generate_index_page: generate an index HTML page summarizing multiple Gaia2 traces with pass/fail stats
